sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
ज्यायसी चेत्कर्मणस्ते मता बुद्धिर्जनार्दन ।
तत्किं कर्मणि घोरे मां नियोजयसि केशव ॥ ३-१॥
iast:
arjuna uvāca
jyāyasī cetkarmaṇaste matā buddhirjanārdana
tatkiṃ karmaṇi ghore māṃ niyojayasi keśava 3-1
translation: Arjuna said: If it be thought by you that knowledge is superior to action, O Janardana, why then, do you, O Kashava, engage me in this terrible action?
